description: Taurus decan 1 (April 20 to April 29): personality, love, work and growth, with Venus as sub-ruler of the first ten degrees of Taurus.
answer: In Western astrology, the first decan of Taurus covers 0° to 9° of the sign, roughly April 20 to April 29, with Venus as its sub-ruler, the sign's own planet. It is read as venusian steadiness, sensuality and loyalty at their most concentrated. Decans are a traditional refinement of the Sun sign.

sections.heading: Taurus decan 1 personality
paragraphs: In the first ten degrees of Taurus, Venus governs both the sign and the decan, so this stretch is usually read as the most unmixed expression of the Bull. The emphasis falls on presence: being fully in the body, in the room, in the season. Natives here are often described as calm, patient and quietly stubborn, with an instinct for what feels good and what lasts. They rarely rush. A favourite chair, a well-made meal, a song played many times over: small, reliable pleasures carry real weight for them, and they tend to protect those pleasures with surprising firmness.

The doubled Venus tone gives this decan a gentle magnetism. People often feel soothed around them, as though the pace of life slows to something manageable. Loyalty is strong and slow to form; once it exists, it runs deep. Yet Venus without a contrasting sub-ruler can also make change feel threatening, so these Taureans may cling to arrangements that have quietly stopped serving them. Traditional writers associated this decan with fertility and cultivation, which translates neatly into a gift for tending things over time. Gardens, friendships, savings and skills all tend to flourish under this patient attention. Hurry, for them, usually spoils the fruit.

sections.heading: Taurus decan 1 in love and at work
paragraphs: First-decan Taurus tends to love through the senses and through constancy. Physical affection, shared meals and a comfortable home often matter more than declarations. They are rarely interested in games and may take a while to commit, testing whether a connection feels steady enough to build on. Once settled, they are devoted and protective. Problems usually come from possessiveness or from avoiding difficult conversations to preserve the peace. A partner who appreciates ritual, offers reassurance and gently invites change, rather than forcing it, tends to bring out their most generous side.

Professionally, this decan often excels where patience and quality are rewarded. Craft trades, design, hospitality, horticulture, music, banking and any role involving tangible results can suit them well. They work steadily, dislike being hurried and tend to produce work that holds up. Frequent reorganisations or chaotic environments can wear them down. Their colleagues often value them as the calm centre of a team. The useful stretch is staying open to new tools and methods, recognising that adapting a familiar process can protect its quality rather than threaten it.

sections.heading: Dates and sub-ruler of Taurus decan 1: what Venus adds
paragraphs: The first decan covers 0° to 9° of Taurus, which in most years means birthdays from April 20 to April 29. First decans take the sign's own ruler, so Venus rules both the sign and this decan, which is why it is often called the purest expression of Taurus. The other two decans of Taurus belong to Mercury (decan 2) and Saturn (decan 3). Because decans are measured in degrees rather than days, the calendar dates drift by a day or so between years.

Venus contributes charm, taste and a pull towards harmony. Its decans tend to be pictured as more sociable and aesthetic, alert to beauty and fairness, and keen to soften conflict through diplomacy, pleasure and good company. Venusian decans are often linked with art, hospitality, partnership and style, and their usual lesson is to say what they want rather than smooth it over. Here Venus doubles up with the sign's own ruler, so Taurus's steadiness, sensual pleasure, patience and quiet determination come through with little filtering.

sections.heading: Growth for Taurus decan 1
paragraphs: Growth for first-decan Taurus usually involves loosening the grip on comfort without abandoning it. Try one small, deliberate change each season: a new route, recipe or routine, chosen rather than imposed. When resistance shows up, ask whether it protects something valuable or simply something familiar. Saying difficult things kindly and early can prevent the slow build-up of resentment that stubbornness sometimes hides. Generosity with time and attention, as well as with material comforts, tends to deepen relationships. Remember that steadiness is strongest when it can bend a little.

Within Taurus, decan 2 leans towards patient hands guided by a practical, curious, problem-solving mind and decan 3 leans towards earthy patience turned into long-term ambition and lasting structures. A decan is one layer of a chart among many, so the Moon, rising sign and houses can strengthen or soften everything described here. These notes work best as prompts for reflection: notice which lines ring true, which feel foreign, and what that contrast suggests.

faq.question: Why is the first decan of Taurus linked so strongly with Venus?
faq.answer: Venus is the ruling planet of Taurus and also the sub-ruler of its first decan, so its themes of beauty, pleasure, loyalty and calm appear in concentrated form. Astrologers often describe these natives as the most sensuous and steady Taureans, sometimes at the cost of flexibility.

faq.question: What are the dates of Taurus decan 1?
faq.answer: In most years April 20 to April 29, the days when the Sun is between 0° and 9° of Taurus. Birthdays at either end can fall in the neighbouring decan in some years.

faq.question: What planet rules Taurus decan 1?
faq.answer: Venus. In the triplicity system each earth sign's decans take the rulers of the earth signs in order, starting with Taurus's own ruler, Venus.
